chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said among what he taught his companions:
"Do not wear black, for it is the clothing of Fir'awn."

key_terms.أَصْحَابَهُ: his companions; those receiving his teaching
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.السَّوَادَ: black clothing; the garment color being addressed
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.فِرْعَوْنَ: Pharaoh; cited as the one associated with this clothing
key_terms.لَا تَلْبَسُوا: do not wear; a prohibitive instruction

ai.seo_question: What did Amir al-Mu'minin Imam Ali عليه السلام say about wearing black?
ai.summary: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام instructs his companions not to wear black, describing it as the clothing of Fir'awn. The hadith conveys a discouragement regarding this form of dress and frames the teaching through moral and legal guidance.
